title: tron.config.checks
description: Schema for TRON's checks.yaml configuration file (PID section 10). Defines which pre-trade checks are enabled and their configured parameters. Contract-owner: WI-C (WO-TRON-D1). The check catalogue itself (names, stage meaning, required inputs, PASS/FAIL/ERROR semantics, MVP/BACKLOG status) is documented in docs/06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md, also owned by WI-C; this schema constrains only the configuration-file shape, kept deliberately consistent with schemas/tron.check_report.v1.json (same check_id identifier pattern, same stage enum [0,1,2,3,4,5,6]) so the two do not drift.

check_id.description: Stable check identifier. Must match an entry in docs/06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md. Same pattern as tron.check_report.v1.check_id.

stage.description: Ordered pre-trade check stage, per PID section 12 (0 = operational safety/kill state, ... 6 = projected post-trade state). Same enum as tron.check_report.v1.stage.

status.description: This check's MVP/BACKLOG classification as documented in docs/06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md section 4. Documentation-level categorisation only; does not itself authorise a capability.

origin.description: PA-13 = a Product Authority check individually named in PID section 13. WI-C-ADD = an engineer-identified addition per PID section 12's minimum-consideration list, explicitly not attributed to Product Authority (PID section 13's own permission for such additions).

check_definition.description: One configured check. parameters is deliberately an open map (additionalProperties: true) because its shape varies per check_id, mirroring the same open-map convention already used by tron.check_report.v1's observed_evidence/configured_parameters (05-CONTRACTS.md section 3).

check_id.description: Must equal the map key this object is stored under in the enclosing checks object (redundant by design, mirroring the contract_version convention in 05-CONTRACTS.md section 2 -- a consumer inspecting one check_definition value in isolation can still identify which check it is).

enabled.description: Whether this check is active at runtime. A BACKLOG-status check may be present in configuration (for forward-compatible documentation of intent) while enabled: false, since its underlying capability does not exist yet.

parameters.description: Configured parameter values for this check (e.g. a threshold), matching the Configuration Parameters column for this check_id in docs/06-CHECKS-CATALOGUE.md. An empty object means this check takes no configured parameters. Open map: shape varies per check_id and is not constrained by this schema (same rationale as tron.check_report.v1.configured_parameters).

checks.description: Map of check_id -> check definition. Using an object keyed by check_id (rather than an array) makes duplicate check_id entries structurally impossible, which an array of objects could not guarantee. Every key must also equal its value's own check_id field (see check_definition.check_id's description); this cross-field equality is enforced by the loader/tests, not expressible as a portable JSON Schema constraint.
